purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0197 in the gauge arena: the lightest color-singlet levels of the paid-string rule on the D4 box against their exact count (every measured ratio 3 to 10 percent below it, the excluded-volume sign), and a three-love baryon (a stand-in proton) held as one singlet in 94 to 99 percent of readings where E-FRC-0171 found no triple held without a paid string, its tensionless control empty.
